description_en: Queries the daily statistics on the distribution of Internet service providers (ISPs) for accelerated domain names. You can query data collected within the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainIspData查询加速域名天粒度的用户运营商分布数据统计，支持获取最近90天的数据
name: DescribeDcdnDomainIspData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. Only a single domain name is supported.

By default, all domain names under your account are queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名。

默认查询当前用户下所有域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval of each record. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒

DomainName.description_en: The information about the accelerated domain name

EndTime.description_en:
The end time.

The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and in UTC
EndTime.description_zh:
结束时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

StartTime.description_en:
The start time.

The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format and in UTC
StartTime.description_zh:
开始时间。

时间采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

IspProportionData.description_en: The list of access proportion data by ISP
IspProportionData.description_zh: 各运营商访问占比数据列表

AvgObjectSize.description_en: The average response size. Unit: bytes

AvgResponseRate.description_en: The average response speed. Unit: bytes per millisecond
AvgResponseRate.description_zh: 平均响应速度，单位：byte/毫秒

AvgResponseTime.description_en: The average response time. Unit: milliseconds
AvgResponseTime.description_zh: 平均响应时间，单位：毫秒

BytesProportion.description_en: The proportion of the total traffic. For example, a value of 90 indicates 90%
BytesProportion.description_zh: 总流量占比。例如：返回90即为90%

IspEname.description_en: The English name of the ISP

Proportion.description_en: The proportion of the usage data
